28:85.text: Verily, He Who has given you
(i.e. ordered you to act on its laws and to preach it to others)
will surely bring you back to Ma‘âd
(place of return, either to Makkah or to Paradise after your death)
: "My Lord is Aware of him who brings guidance, and of him who is in manifest error."

28:86.text: And you were not expecting that the Book
would be sent down to you, but it is a mercy from your Lord. So never be a supporter of the disbelievers.

28:87.text: And let them not turn you
of Allâh after they have been sent down to you: and invite
(those who associate partners with Allâh, e.g. polytheists, pagans, idolaters, and those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allâh and deny the Prophethood of Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

28:88.text: And invoke not any other ilâh
along with Allâh: Lâ ilâha illa Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
. Everything will perish save His Face. His is the Decision, and to Him you

29:2.text: Do people think that they will be left alone because they say: "We believe," and will not be tested.

29:3.text: And We indeed tested those who were before them. And Allâh will certainly make
those who are true, and will certainly make

29:4.text: Or think those who do evil deeds that they can outstrip Us
? Evil is that which they judge!

29:5.text: with Allâh, then Allâh’s Term is surely coming and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
